expected_refusals.detail: comparison d16fe4449194774a8ca629c3c34597de was already classified resolved_by_stage by event 0000000000000000000000000000000b — one classification per comparison, because the edge id carries the kind and a second verdict would open a second edge rather than amend the first
comparison d16fe4449194774a8ca629c3c34597de classified resolved_by_stage, which RESOLVED the pair apart — opening an edge over it is the crying-wolf failure this whole pipeline exists to prevent
comparison 00000000000000000000000000000000 was never detected or registered — a classification of a pair nobody put forward is a verdict with no case
the classification's endpoints are not the tuple comparison 2822c2c578c15128199506ec0d7c56a9 was minted from — side for side, because both bodies order left as the canonically-first endpoint

outcome same_meaning is a semantic judgement and arrives only through an applied classify_conflict proposal — a deterministic rule claiming it would put a model's job in the reducer with none of the review

outcome resolved_by_stage is a typed comparison over recorded qualifiers and is deterministic only — a model that could decide it could resolve a real conflict away by being confident about arithmetic
proposal 1111111111111111111111111111111b was made by claude-opus-5/classify-conflict-v1, and this event credits some-other-model/classify-conflict-v1 — an agent_supplied verdict IS its attribution
proposal 1111111111111111111111111111111b asked for same_meaning, and this event records genuine_direct — the review answered a different question

edge a51b3fd02a735bd0c3705441ef296aa9 was already opened by event 00000000000000000000000000000017 — exact replay is deduplicated at the door by `contradiction-open:<store>:<edge>`, so a second event reaching the reducer is a duplicate append
comparison 2822c2c578c15128199506ec0d7c56a9 classified genuine_direct, which opens a genuine_direct edge, and this opens a partial — the kind is in the edge id, so these are two different edges
addressed_by_event_id 00000000000000000000000000000002 is not a member of this batch — a close travels with the mutation that addressed the edge, and there is no standalone close path
addressed_by_event_id is this close's own event — a close cannot be what addressed the contradiction
